from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from refproj.inventory import StockItem, transfer

FLOOR = StockItem(sku="W-1", unit_price=Decimal("2.50"), on_hand=4)
BACK_ROOM = StockItem(sku="W-1", unit_price=Decimal("2.40"), on_hand=10)
GADGET = StockItem(sku="G-7", unit_price=Decimal("9.00"), on_hand=6)


def test_transfer_moves_units_from_source_to_target() -> None:
    source, target = transfer(BACK_ROOM, FLOOR, 3)
    assert (source.on_hand, target.on_hand) == (7, 7)


def test_transfer_neither_loses_nor_makes_stock() -> None:
    source, target = transfer(BACK_ROOM, FLOOR, 3)
    assert source.on_hand + target.on_hand == BACK_ROOM.on_hand + FLOOR.on_hand


def test_transfer_keeps_skus_and_unit_prices() -> None:
    source, target = transfer(BACK_ROOM, FLOOR, 3)
    assert (source.sku, source.unit_price) == ("W-1", Decimal("2.40"))
    assert (target.sku, target.unit_price) == ("W-1", Decimal("2.50"))


def test_transfer_leaves_the_arguments_untouched() -> None:
    source = StockItem(sku="W-1", unit_price=Decimal("2.40"), on_hand=10)
    target = StockItem(sku="W-1", unit_price=Decimal("2.50"), on_hand=4)
    moved_source, moved_target = transfer(source, target, 3)
    assert (source.on_hand, target.on_hand) == (10, 4)
    assert moved_source is not source and moved_target is not target


def test_transfer_of_everything_on_hand_empties_the_source() -> None:
    source, target = transfer(FLOOR, BACK_ROOM, 4)
    assert (source.on_hand, target.on_hand) == (0, 14)


def test_cannot_transfer_between_different_skus() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="different SKUs"):
        transfer(GADGET, FLOOR, 1)


def test_cannot_transfer_a_non_positive_quantity() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="quantity must be positive"):
        transfer(BACK_ROOM, FLOOR, 0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="quantity must be positive"):
        transfer(BACK_ROOM, FLOOR, -1)


def test_cannot_transfer_more_than_source_has_on_hand() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="only 4"):
        transfer(FLOOR, BACK_ROOM, 5)


def test_different_skus_is_reported_before_a_bad_quantity() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="different SKUs"):
        transfer(GADGET, FLOOR, 0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="different SKUs"):
        transfer(GADGET, FLOOR, 7)


def test_non_positive_quantity_is_reported_before_a_shortage() -> None:
    overdrawn = StockItem(sku="W-1", unit_price=Decimal("2.50"), on_hand=-2)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="quantity must be positive"):
        transfer(overdrawn, FLOOR, -1)

def test_different_skus_is_reported_before_a_bad_quantity() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="different SKUs"):
        transfer(GADGET, FLOOR, 0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="different SKUs"):
        transfer(GADGET, FLOOR, 11)


def test_non_positive_quantity_is_reported_before_a_shortage() -> None:
    overdrawn = StockItem(sku="W-1", unit_price=Decimal("2.50"), on_hand=-2)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="quantity must be positive"):
        transfer(overdrawn, FLOOR, -1)
